text:
LumenPath-PO: hi team, we're ready to start onboarding our clinical triage model. key constraints: no PHI exposure in outputs, token-level redaction required, target p95 latency <= 350ms, expected steady-state ~30 rps. we also need to add ~15k domain tokens to the tokenizer. can redwood support private on-prem deployment + vocab additions?

Ava (CSM): thanks! capturing the ask. tagging @Miguel for compatibility checks and @Priya for safety review. heads-up: renewal in ~60 days so we'll prioritize this intake.

Miguel (SE): quick clarifying Qs: 1) are the 15k tokens finalized or iterative? 2) do you have redacted sample inputs and expected labels for triage outputs? token additions can affect KV cache layout and quantization fallback.

LumenPath-PO (customer): tokens are mostly finalized but may have small follow-ups. we'll upload a redacted sample set (2000 prompts) and the label schema. prefer private on-prem deployment due to PHI.

onboard-bot: Secure upload link created: https://files.redwood.com/secure-upload/lumen-xyz (expires in 7 days).

Priya (Safety): flagged. Requirements for PHI workloads: disabled raw-token logging for the tenant, KMS-backed key management for artifacts, optional HSM wrap, and an eval for prompt-injection hallucinatory behavior. please complete the safety intake template: https://redwood.inc/safety-templates/lumenpath (upload creds are ephemeral).

Miguel (SE): I'll run a conversion + tokenization compatibility job on a Dedicated staging harness first to check embedding alignment and quantized model paths. need from customer: samples (2000), token-add list (CSV), label set, and an initial model file or weight tarball (if available). ETA for initial compatibility report: EOD Friday.

Miguel (SE): example eval command for the staging harness:
```bash
# staging eval runner
curl -s -X POST https://staging.internal.redwood/eval \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <STAGING_KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"cases": "s3://secure-upload/lumenpath/samples.jsonl", "metrics": ["p95_latency","accuracy","hallucination_rate"]}'
```

LumenPath-PO (customer): uploading samples now to the secure link. confirm that token-level logs will be turned off and that KMS policies will be enforced prior to accepting artifacts?

Priya (Safety): confirmed: token-level logging off for that tenant; only aggregated telemetry retained. KMS required; we will not accept artifacts without proper key wrapping. we'll run the safety tests including prompt-injection hammer tests and hallucination spot-checks.

Sophie (RevOps): noted on the renewal timeline. i'll open a renewal watch and add these onboarding milestones as acceptance criteria so contracting and success are aligned.

Ava (CSM): setting up an enablement + kickoff call. proposed: Wed 10am PT. will also create an account health playbook entry and raise internal escalation if we hit infra or KMS blockers.

Miguel (SE): action items for me: 1) spin up Dedicated staging harness and run tokenization check, 2) report any token collisions or quantization incompatibilities, 3) run baseline latency on the private infra config. i'll post findings here by EOD Friday.

Priya (Safety): action items: review safety template tomorrow, confirm required redaction hooks and telemetry masking, and prepare the PI/exfiltration test plan.

Ava (CSM): acceptance criteria for go/no-go: pass safety checklist, p95 <= 350ms in Private on-prem tests, successful KMS/HSM key wrap validation, and ingestible token map.

LumenPath-PO (customer): great — we'll join Wed at 10. appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

Ava (CSM): thanks all. summarizing tasks: Miguel -> compat eval (EOD Fri), Priya -> safety template & test plan (tomorrow), Sophie -> renewal watch ticket, LumenPath -> upload final token CSV + samples, Ava -> kickoff invite + account note. updating thread as we progress.
